sections.title: SYFHome-Hub, my home server
sections.description: A NixOS box whose configuration lives in Git: the whole system rebuilds from a single file, so reinstalling it is reproducible rather than an exercise in memory. Everything is published through a Cloudflare Tunnel, without opening a single port on the router.

items.name: NixOS
items.description: Declarative operating system. The configuration lives in a repo and is applied with one command.

items.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
items.description: Publishes services to the internet with no open ports and no need for a static IP.

items.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
items.description: Reverse proxy sitting in front of every internal service.

items.name: AdGuard Home
items.description: Ad-blocking DNS and DHCP server for the whole home network.

items.name: Paperless-NGX
items.description: Document management: every piece of paper scanned, indexed and searchable.

items.name: wg-easy
items.description: WireGuard VPN with a web UI to reach the network from outside.

items.name: Docker
items.description: Services that aren't NixOS modules run in containers.
